name: star-emperor
author: BlaXun
description: Star Emperor in pre-renewal, as the Star Gladiator's rebirth. A Star Gladiator at 99/50 is reborn as a Novice, becomes a Taekwon again with transcendent stat points, and from Taekwon job 40 becomes a Star Emperor, to job 70: the same skill points and gear rules as any transcendent class. The skills are scaled to sit a little below the transcendent classes, and four tiers of Star Emperor gear (levels 50 to 95) drop from monsters.
